x['cancelled_bool']=x.cancelled.astype(str).str.lower().eq('true')

x['actual_min']=x.actual_dep.where(~x.cancelled_bool).str.slice(0,2).astype('Int64')*60+x.actual_dep.where(~x.cancelled_bool).str.slice(3,5).astype('Int64')
x['delay']=x['actual_min']-x['sched_min']
x.loc[x.delay<0,'delay'] += 1440
completed=x[~x.cancelled_bool]
print('completed',len(completed),'delayed', (completed.delay>15).sum(), 'rate', (completed.delay>15).mean()*100)
print('delay stats', completed.delay.describe().to_dict(), 'negative after adjust', (completed.delay<0).sum())
print('by month', completed.assign(month=pd.to_datetime(completed.date).dt.month).groupby('month').delay.agg(n='size',delayed=lambda s:(s>15).sum()))
# duplicates handling result compare
u=x.drop_duplicates('flight_id')
cu=u[~u.cancelled_bool]
print('dedup completed/delayed/rate',len(cu),(cu.delay>15).sum(),(cu.delay>15).mean()*100)

import pandas as pd, glob, os
files=glob.glob('airlines/*.csv')
print(files)
for f in files:
    df=pd.read_csv(f)
    print('\n',f, df.shape, df.columns.tolist(), 'dup rows',df.duplicated().sum(),'dup ids',df.flight_id.duplicated().sum(), 'cancelled',df.cancelled.value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict())
    print(df.head(2).to_string(index=False))
# combine and compute, after dedupe exact repeated records / flight id
allf=pd.concat([pd.read_csv(f).assign(carrier=os.path.basename(f)[:2]) for f in files],ignore_index=True)
print('\ncombined',allf.shape,'unique ids',allf.flight_id.nunique(),'dup id rows',allf.flight_id.duplicated().sum())
print('date range',allf.date.min(),allf.date.max())
print('cancelled strings',allf.cancelled.unique())
print('duplicate id conflicting records', allf.groupby('flight_id').size().value_counts().to_dict())
# dedupe exact and by id
u=allf.drop_duplicates(subset=['flight_id']).copy()
# use minute clocks and midnight rollover where actual < sched
s=pd.to_datetime(u.sched_dep,format='%H:%M')
a=pd.to_datetime(u.actual_dep,format='%H:%M',errors='coerce')
delay=(a-s).dt.total_seconds()/60
# add day for negative completed differences (likely after midnight)
delay=delay.where(delay>=0,delay+1440)
u['delay']=delay
u['month']=pd.to_datetime(u.date).dt.month
completed=u[(u.cancelled==False) & u.actual_dep.notna()]
print('completed',len(completed),'delayed >15', (completed.delay>15).sum(),'rate',100*(completed.delay>15).mean())
print('month',completed.groupby('month').agg(n=('flight_id','size'),delayed=('delay',lambda x:(x>15).sum()),rate=('delay',lambda x:100*(x>15).mean())).to_string())
print('delay stats',completed.delay.describe().to_string())
print('negative raw examples',allf[(allf.actual_dep.notna()) & (pd.to_datetime(allf.actual_dep,format='%H:%M')<pd.to_datetime(allf.sched_dep,format='%H:%M'))][['flight_id','date','sched_dep','actual_dep']].head(10).to_string(index=False))

import pandas as pd, glob, os
rows=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 d=pd.read_csv(f); c=os.path.basename(f)[:2]
 datecol='date_utc' if 'date_utc' in d else 'date'; scol='sched_dep_utc' if 'sched_dep_utc' in d else 'sched_dep'; acol='actual_dep_utc' if 'actual_dep_utc' in d else 'actual_dep'
 d=d.rename(columns={datecol:'date',scol:'sched',acol:'actual'}); d['carrier']=c
 rows.append(d[['flight_id','date','sched','actual','cancelled','carrier']])
u=pd.concat(rows,ignore_index=True).drop_duplicates('flight_id')
s=pd.to_datetime(u.sched,format='%H:%M'); a=pd.to_datetime(u.actual,format='%H:%M',errors='coerce')
u['raw']=(a-s).dt.total_seconds()/60
print('unique',len(u),'completed',((~u.cancelled)&u.actual.notna()).sum())
print('raw negative distribution',u.loc[(~u.cancelled)&u.actual.notna() & (u.raw<0),'raw'].describe().to_string())
print('most negative / likely rollover')
print(u[(u.raw < -60)&(~u.cancelled)][['flight_id','date','sched','actual','raw','carrier']].to_string(index=False))
# Count rates raw, only rollover if raw<-60
comp=u[(~u.cancelled)&u.actual.notna()].copy(); comp['delay']=comp.raw.where(comp.raw>=-60,comp.raw+1440)
print('raw rate', (comp.raw>15).sum(),len(comp),100*(comp.raw>15).mean())
print('corrected', (comp.delay>15).sum(),len(comp),100*(comp.delay>15).mean())
print('carrier',comp.groupby('carrier').agg(n=('flight_id','size'),delayed=('delay',lambda x:(x>15).sum()),rate=('delay',lambda x:100*(x>15).mean())).to_string())
print('zero/negative fixed examples',comp[comp.raw<-60].to_string(index=False))

events.notes: Combined all six carrier files, normalized AS's *_utc column names, removed repeated flight_id records, excluded cancellations, and computed actual minus scheduled departure in minutes. For post-midnight actual departures, added 1,440 minutes when the clock difference indicated next-day departure. Result: 453 delayed completed flights out of 1,894, or 23.9%.
